messages:
sam: quick UX flag — compact dashboard uses decimal suffixes like '0.5k' and our beta testers were confused. they expected '500' not '0.5k'. thoughts on a consistent rule?
yana: saw that. proposal: use full integers for values < 10,000, otherwise use compact with max 1 decimal (e.g. 12.3k). avoids weird 0.5k. also show full value in tooltip always.
praveen: agree with tooltip. also add accessible text for charts: screen readers should announce the raw value, not the short form. aria-hidden the abbreviated label, provide aria-label on the value node: "500".
claudia: on smoothing: suggest renaming to "Trend smoothing" with small subtitle "Temporarily reduces short spikes for readability. Visual only." default OFF. place toggle inline in header next to timeframe selector for discoverability.
a11y-bot: checklist: toggles must be keyboard operable, include aria-pressed and aria-describedby linking to description. live region updates: "Trend smoothing enabled" / "Trend smoothing disabled".
ops-bot: FYI deploy note: new format change will impact CSV export column headings if we switch server-side formatting. keep formatting in client rendering layer.
yana: good call — client-only. also tick density idea: in compact rows reduce ticks to ceil(width / 80) and remove minor ticks under that. prevents label overlap.
praveen: clipping behavior: opt-in clip menu in header with options: "Show full range" / "Clip at 98th percentile" / "Annotate outliers". visual cue when clipped: dashed cap line + small badge "clipped" with tooltip showing actual max. do NOT auto-clip without consent.
claudia: microcopy for spike detection CTA: "Large spike detected — display clipped view?" buttons: "Clip" / "Show full". trigger threshold: new spike > 4x median over last 15m.
yana: legend adjustments for compact mode: collapse into a single labeled dropdown on narrow viewports (<480px). markers down to 6px, label font 12px, maintain 44px tap target via invisible padding.
a11y-bot: contrast check reminder: label text must meet AA against both light and dark backgrounds. also ensure focus ring visible for legend dropdown items.
praveen: code snippet for formatting to share with frontend: 
```
function compactFormat(value, locale) {
  const abs = Math.abs(value);
  if (abs < 10000) return value.toLocaleString();
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {notation: 'compact', compactDisplay: 'short', maximumFractionDigits: 1}).format(value);
}
```
claudia: microcopy for abbreviated tooltip: show both forms e.g. "12.3k → 12,300" on hover/focus. also include copy when clipped: "Displayed up to 98th percentile; highest value was 512,000".
sam: can someone add visual specs (marker sizes, tick spacing, badge icon) to the Figma file and I'll create the ticket?
yana: I'll add specs + a compact mock. filing design task: D-1199 chart-compact-formatting.
praveen: i'll draft the accessibility notes and share in the ticket.
claudia: thanks team. small wins = fewer misunderstanding data reads. :party_parrot:
